meta_title: M A Decor | Painter & Decorator Sheffield
meta_description: M A Decor is your local Sheffield painter and decorator. Professional interior and exterior work, competitive rates, free quotes. Call 07984 403679 today.
hero_eyebrow: Experienced Local Decorator — Quality Finish Guaranteed
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. From single rooms to whole properties, we deliver a professional finish on time and within budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting and Decorating Services Across Sheffield
services_subhead: Whether it's a fresh coat of emulsion, exterior cladding, or a full room makeover, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Fresh walls transform a room. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium paints, and deliver flawless finishes in any colour you choose.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof your home with durable exterior paint. We work in all conditions and protect woodwork, masonry, and metal from the elements.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional hanging of any wallpaper style — from feature walls to full rooms. We remove old paper, prepare walls, and ensure perfectly aligned patterns.

services.title: Wood Staining and Varnishing
services.desc: Enhance natural timber with quality stains and varnishes. Ideal for doors, skirting, fascias, and garden features.

services.title: Commercial Decorating
services.desc: Fast, efficient painting for shops, offices, and warehouses. We work around your schedule, manage site cleanliness, and minimise disruption.

services.title: Damp and Preparation Work
services.desc: Correct damp issues and prepare surfaces properly — the foundation of any lasting finish. We treat mould, repair damage, and prime before painting.

about_pullquote: Honest work, fair prices, and no shortcuts — that's how I run this business.
about_para_1: M A Decor was founded on the principle that good decoration shouldn't be complicated or expensive. With over 15 years in the trade, we've painted hundreds of Sheffield homes and businesses, earning a reputation for reliability and attention to detail. Every project starts with a proper site visit and a clear quote — no surprises.
about_para_2: We listen to what you want and deliver it on time. Our customers trust us because we take pride in preparation, use quality materials, and finish every job to the same high standard. Whether it's a small refresh or a major renovation, we treat your property with respect.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Homeowners Say About M A Decor

reviews.text: Had the lounge and hallway completely redecorated. Mark was really professional — prepared everything properly, no mess, and the finish is perfect. Much better than the last decorator we used. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: External woodwork painted beautifully. We were worried about the weather but Mark got it done ahead of schedule and the paint's already proving tough. Great bloke, honest quote, no hassle.
reviews.author: Christine T.

reviews.text: Two-bedroom terraced house done inside and out. The preparation work was meticulous and it shows in the finish. Fair price too. Highly recommend if you're in Sheffield.
reviews.author: James M.
